subject: Which account do you have for us?
text:
Hi, doing some housekeeping. Can you tell me which bank account you have on file for Brightline? We've been shutting down older ones and I need to make sure you get moved over to the current one before yours gets rejected.

Thanks!
Sheila
label: change_request
note: Probing for the on-file details, but explicitly says the reader will be moved to a different account.
